description: Figure 8 displays the results of shared Top-6 routed experts in two independent samples of a task. The x-axis represents the sample size, with values ranging from 1 to 32, and the y-axis shows the shared Top-6 routed experts averaged by model layers, with values ranging from 0 to 1. The plot contains two lines, one in red and one in blue. The red line starts at a y-value of approximately 0.8 when the sample size is 1, and it decreases to a value of approximately 0.2 as the sample size increases to 32. The blue line starts at a y-value of approximately 0.7 when the sample size is 1, and it decreases to a value of approximately 0.1 as the sample size increases to 32. Both lines show a general downward trend as the sample size increases.
